definitions.explanation: Targeting something with great precision. Used for accurate targeting of a specific location, time, or topic.

examples.japanese: ピンポイント⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧。
ピンポイントな⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was asked a very precise question.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ピンポイント⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{降水|こうすい}{確率|かくりつ}→降水確率：25563_kousuikakuritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I checked the pinpoint precipitation probability on the weather forecast.

notes:
From English "pinpoint." Used to describe extreme precision in targeting a location, time, topic, or point. Functions as both a noun (ピンポイント⟦で→で：00502_de⟧) and a na-adjective (ピンポイントな).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ピンポイント⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧: to target precisely
- ピンポイント⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧: pinpoint forecast (location-specific weather)
- ピンポイントな⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧: precise observation/criticism
- ピンポイント⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to reach exactly the right spot
- ピンポイント⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to hit right on the mark

USAGE:
Very common in weather forecasts (ピンポイント⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧) and business contexts. Unlike English, where "pinpoint" is mainly a verb or adjective, in Japanese it is primarily a noun used with で or な.
